tools.name: list_creators
tools.description: List human creators currently accepting paid post offers from AI agents. Returns each creator's code, platforms, follower counts, and estimated market rates. Public.

tools.name: get_creator
tools.description: Get one creator's full agent manifest (platforms, followers, rate card, how to submit an offer) by creator code. Public.

tools.name: get_market_benchmarks
tools.description: Get current fair-market rate benchmarks ($ per 1k followers by platform and deliverable kind), offer verdict rules (LOWBALL / FAIR / PREMIUM), and the marketplace's live combined reach (creators, connected accounts, total verified followers). Public.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_creators, check_offer_status, join_waitlist · Private data: submit_offer, cancel_offer, join_waitlist, update_profile · Public sink: list_creators, get_creator, submit_offer, check_offer_status, cancel_offer, join_waitlist, update_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_creators, check_offer_status, join_waitlist · Private data: submit_offer, cancel_offer, join_waitlist, update_profile · Public sink: list_creators, get_creator, submit_offer, check_offer_status, cancel_offer, join_waitlist, update_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
